name: bank_routing
instructions: What is this digital-bank customer's message about? Pick the most specific matching issue.
state_template:
Customer message to bank support chat:
{{input}}

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or charge on the statement that the customer says they did not make or do not recognise
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal shown in the app that the customer did not make or does not recognise, or cash missing from their account according to the app
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up or does not recognise
criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks their card or account was compromised or used by someone else; suspected fraud
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Customer's card (or wallet) is lost or stolen and needs reporting or freezing
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer lost their phone or it was stolen
criteria.passcode_or_login: Forgot app passcode, passcode not accepted, locked out of the app, cannot log in
criteria.pin_blocked_or_change_pin: PIN blocked, forgotten or rejected, or changing an existing PIN (including at an ATM)
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept/swallowed/took the customer's card
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund for a purchase, changed their mind, cancelled a purchase, or goods not received
criteria.refund_not_showing: A merchant refund the customer expects has not appeared on their statement
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than requested, or the customer did not get or receive the cash they requested
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A payment the customer already made was cancelled, terminated or reverted by the app or merchant, came back, or has disappeared and can't be found (not the customer asking to cancel something)
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge, extra fee or small unexpected amount on the statement that the customer asks about ("what is this fee on my statement?", "a pending £1 charge"), even if they say they bought nothing for that amount
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_own_transaction: Customer says the exchange rate applied to their own card purchase or cash withdrawal was wrong, or that exchanging cost them more than it should
criteria.cash_abroad_rate_or_fee: Exchange rate or fees specifically for withdrawing cash from an ATM abroad or in a foreign currency (even phrased generally), e.g. weekend rates for getting cash
criteria.dispute_transaction: Customer wants to dispute a transaction
criteria.activate_card: Activating a new card; is the card ready to use
criteria.card_arrival_delivery: When the card will arrive, delivery time or date, tracking, card not yet received
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, replacement card for expiring card, spare or additional cards, and fees for getting cards or delivery
criteria.virtual_card: Getting or using a virtual or disposable virtual card, its limits, or it not working
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working, contactless not working, card keeps getting declined
criteria.declined_or_pending_card_payment: A card payment at a shop/online was declined, or is still pending
criteria.declined_or_pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM refused, declined or would not let the customer withdraw money (even with the right PIN), a cash withdrawal is still pending, or the balance doesn't look right after a withdrawal
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app, or reactivating a lost card that was found
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which card the customer gets or can choose: whether the bank's card is Visa or Mastercard, asking for one, choosing their card, or whether they can use their Visa or Mastercard
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / can be used
criteria.get_first_pin: Getting the PIN for a new card, where is my PIN, setting PIN on a new card
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card can be used at
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up through them
criteria.transfer_status: A bank transfer is pending, how long transfers take, transfer not arrived or not received by recipient
criteria.failed_or_declined_transfer: A bank transfer failed, was declined, or a beneficiary is not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer asks how to cancel a transfer or transaction they made, or a transfer sent to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money, transferring money into the account, SWIFT, transfers from other banks
criteria.balance_not_updated: Balance not updated after a bank transfer, cash or cheque deposit
criteria.top_up: Topping up the account: how to, by card, by cash/cheque, auto top-up, top-up limits, top-up pending, failed, declined or reverted
criteria.fee_charged: A fee charged for a card payment, a cash withdrawal, a transfer, or a top-up; questions about such fees
criteria.exchange_rate_info: Neutral questions about exchange rates: what the rate is, how rates are set
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.currency_and_card_support: Which currencies can be held or exchanged; which cards and currencies are supported in general or can be used to top up; other card brands such as American Express
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: documents needed, why, verification failing
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code, why a top-up must be verified
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account
criteria.exchange_fee_question: Questions about whether there is a fee for exchanging currencies, how much currency exchange costs, or exchange discounts (without saying their own exchange was wrong)
